reasons: The playbook's preferred position is 'No non-solicit on Customer,' so the absence of any solicitation/no-hire covenant satisfies the preferred position; classifying as compliant is correct.
Cited paragraphs (Exhibit D §5 personnel dedication and §14.5 independent contractors) contain no restrictive covenant, supporting the rationale that no non-solicit binds the Customer.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed and the original text is left unchanged.
The failed deterministic checks (duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are expected artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause to measure, not evidence of a defect.
